item.title: An Unwelcome Audience
item.ns0:summary: A recorder left in the woods. A deer that isn't quite right. And a narrator who's curiousity just surpasses his sense of danger. Todays episode is written by Steven Schrembeck or as you might know him from Reddit, Kasai_Ryane. It's been one of my favorite Nosleep stories for a long time, so we're very excited to share it with our listeners. Send us a message!
